description: Claude Code plugins for running Scrum on GitHub.

plugins.description: Run Scrum on GitHub: sprints as milestones, tasks as issues, automatic status from pull requests, burndown reports and daily digests, AI planning from a requirement to an epic, features and tasks, AI agents that work tasks into one pull request ready for review, and releases with notes from the Done tasks.
